newsitem.title: USA: Alliance Gaming CEO, chairman to leave.
newsitem.headline: Alliance Gaming CEO, chairman to leave.

text.p: Alliance Gaming Corp said on Wednesday that Steve Greathouse, its chairman, president and chief executive officer, is leaving effective December 31.
The company said Greathouse will work with his successor to ensure a smooth transition and oversee Alliance Gaming's growth plan until year-end.
Greathouse said shareholder interests would be better served by a new CEO who could make a longer-term commitment to Alliance.
The company did not immediately provide the name of a successor.
